question: HYDRAULIC-001's cooling efficiency looks low compared with earlier cycles — what do the sensors show?
notes: data/sensors/hydraulic_001.csv is real recorded data (UCI hydraulic test rig, seeded via scripts/seed_sensor_data.py after scripts/download_real_sensor_data.py), 2,205 one-minute cycles with the cooler degraded in about two thirds of them. No manual states a threshold for these metrics, so no severity floor is forced; this scenario only checks that the agent queried sensor history and returned sensor_reading evidence.
